references.label: Briefcase targets
references.description: Three targets used to qualify Briefcase Boogie locks.

references.label: center bank
references.description: Choose the harder center route when the center bank and pawn-shop hole are behaving better than the Briefcase targets and left kicker.

references.label: Pawn Shop drops
references.description: Center bank used to expose the pawn-shop lock and payoff hole.

references.label: Briefcase kicker
references.description: Left-side kicker used for Briefcase payoffs and Divine Intervention.

references.label: pop bumpers
references.description: Scene choice: The lit Scene can change while the ball is in the slingshots and pop bumpers.

references.label: Scene saucer
references.description: Right saucer used to start and collect Scenes.

references.label: right-target
references.description: Divine Intervention: Complete the briefcase bank, three left-kicker shots, three pawn-shop shots, five right-target hits, five top-saucer shots, all seven red arrows, and the magnet target.

references.label: Roll Scene shot
references.description: Choose this separate multiball route when the inline Briefcase targets and left kicker are more reliable than the Roll Scene shot.

references.label: Roll Scene target
references.description: Hit the right Roll Scene target before entering the top saucer, then shoot the right saucer to start the Scene.

references.label: top saucer
references.description: Hit the right Roll Scene target before entering the top saucer, then shoot the right saucer to start the Scene.
